body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: f72b3366b25af17d67bdd57a89c6ab050103463b -->
**Not built - needs a maintainer look.** The app/ui changes are the core of this PR and none of the workspace crates they touch can compile in this review environment (no C compiler anywhere: `ring` needs `cc1`, which this box lacks — the PR's own `cargo xtask gate` wedged on the same box per the PR body), and the `camcraft-pr-test` runner is collaborator-only (the author is not a collaborator), so nothing was built for the PR head. The only touched crate that builds and tests cleanly here is `camcraft-sim`. Read, not built.

What looks good:
- Clean, layered wiring: params/dto/project grammar (v82), the generate arm, the MCP pick door, the UI editor, icons, and the tests all follow the rotary twins' laws with the station window the picks replaced threaded everywhere (`params`, `sane`, `stamp`, `posting`, `fixture`, `setup_sheet/heights`, `interact`, `area`, `posting_wcs_rotation`, `setup_wcs_flip`) — no stray arm left behind.
- The heights law is stated consistently (ball-center radii against the work radius, the kernel's own guard) and pinned by `rotary_flow_band` and the v82 round-trip test.
- The digest/kinds ordering stays consistent (tag 48 == row position 48; tests updated in lockstep).
- The unused unrelated hunks are output-neutral (see Questions).

Results merged with main (trial merge clean, `MERGEABLE` via the API; none of this is a runner run):
- `camcraft-sim` lib tests: 252 passed, 0 failed (`cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib`, worktree target).
- `camcraft-sim` clippy (`--all-targets -- -D warnings`): clean.
- `cargo xtask icons --check`: 0 breach(es) — the new `op-rotary-flow` SVG/PNG are consistent.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app` / `-p camcraft-ui`: not run — the build fails at `ring` (missing `cc1`) before any crate compiles.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app` / `-p camcraft-ui`: not run — same blocker.
- The `camcraft-app`/`camcraft-ui` test binaries the diff touches (`operations`, `project_roundtrip`, `rotary_flow_band`, `setup_align_multiaxis`, `ribbon`, `example_catalog/refusal`, `ui lib`): not run — same blocker.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): not run — release build of app/motion/kernel twins needs the same `ring` compiler. Full lanes were not run (not required at review; the issue is `P6`, no `P1` safety floor step owed).
- Example-catalog suites: not run — need `camcraft-app` to build.

Requested before merge (1-2 must be answered by the author or the maintainer):
1. `crates/app/tests/rotary_flow_band.rs` (new top-level file, not in `ISOLATED` or `SLOW_BINARIES`): the PR body gives no one-line reason for it. Per AGENTS.md "New tests join a directory suite", add the reason line to the body (or move the file into a directory suite).
2. Missing the MCP follow-up naming: the body says Rotary Flow's MCP tooling is "tracked as the follow-up `MCP: <command>` row of the umbrella" — the follow-up issue is not named or filed. The MCP pick door (`crates/app/src/mcp/pick.rs`) is in this PR and only validates picks; the fuller tool row needs a `source:agent` issue named in the body.

Questions / notes (not blocking):
- `params.rs` (the digest module) lost its `Provenance:` line in this PR (`crates/app/src/operation/params.rs:1-4`); AGENTS.md asks for a one-line provenance comment per module. Cheap to restore.
- Unrelated hunks in this PR, unnamed in the body: `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs` / `first_traverse.rs` (an output-neutral reflow of the `FirstTraverseLow` message, verified identical output) and `crates/app/tests/example_catalog/refusal.rs` (CRLF normalization of `committed`). Both harmless; mention them in the body (or split them out) so the diff stays one-purpose.
- The radial field law is not verified on the band end-to-end: the test comments say the posting of a clean band path is held out because the kernel's 0.25 mm cell quantization reads the convex crease ring as a gouge (the finding is reported on the issue) — the issue has no such comment, so either post it on the issue or soften the test comments. This is noted, not blocking (posting is not exercised by the PR, only generation).
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is already far above 400 lines (~8 200). The +100 lines there (and the same for `kinds.rs`) are worth watching, but out of scope for this PR.
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is not touched; no process files changed, so no `Process change: yes` line is needed. `Refs #2826` is right for a partial slice (MCP row pending). `Changelog:` line present. No snapshot PNG changes, no golden changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
